title: Read-Only Area
prompt: Create a class Rect(w, h) with a read-only property area (no setter). Assigning to area must raise AttributeError.

tests.name: assignment raises
tests.code:
r = Rect(2, 2)
try:
    r.area = 10
    failed = False
except AttributeError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: A property without a setter cannot be assigned.
